notes:
• Added Ultra Modular. Mix gauges, music, lyrics, maps, and vehicle data in resizable tiles, and save your own presets.
• Added an album-art background option, borderless tiles, and album-colored Ultra Sound gauges to Ultra Modular.
• Added Ultra Lyrics with synced lines, phrase animations, and a six-band visualizer. Choose Lyrics in the mini player to follow one line at a time.
• Ultra Modular and Ultra Lyrics appear first in the deck library with a NEW tag until you open them.
• On mobile, Ultra Modular can follow your desktop layout or use a separate layout saved on your phone.
